evidence_labels.web-verified: Source page or indexed text was opened and checked.
evidence_labels.score-example-verified: Author score-example locator and stated measure span were checked; this alone does not establish a fresh note transcription.
evidence_labels.full-score-verified: Primary facsimile notation was visually inspected for the stated fact, except where explicitly limited to a page locator.
evidence_labels.audio-unverified: No audio was opened or listened to.

claims.claim: Kopp describes an extended A-sharp pedal in mm. 20-22 and a direct return to F-sharp at m. 24 after an A-sharp major triad.
claims.limit: The harmonic wording is Kopp's analysis, not a fresh reduction.

claims.claim: The wording that the main melody temporarily retreats is not established as literal disappearance/rest in checked Kopp prose. PTNA labels mm. 17-23 an Interlude as secondary section analysis.
claims.limit: No bar-by-bar claim of melody absence is made.

claims.claim: Kopp says theme A/A-prime returns at m. 24 with double trills, melodic diminution and textural amplification; Example 5 is labelled mm. 23-35.
claims.limit: No separate event or boundary is inferred at m. 25, 26 or 27.

claims.claim: The sources support a return at m. 24 and a longer span, not multiple independently established segmentation boundaries within mm. 24-27.
The 1846 French First Edition p. 4 visibly prints rallent. in the system containing m. 34. PTNA says the indication begins on beat 2. Kopp does not mention it.
claims.limit: The primary score mark is rallent.; this review found no basis for substituting rit.

claims.claim: Kopp says the inner-voice A-sharp 4 becomes A-natural on its fourth appearance at m. 35.
claims.limit: No affect or boundary interpretation is made.

claims.claim: CFEO maps mm. 185-202 to p. 11 and mm. 203-222 to p. 12. Inspected p. 11 shows upper-staff chord attacks over a running left-hand sixteenth-note arpeggiation and later more continuous figuration.
claims.limit: Page-level observation only; no feature is assigned to a specific bar. P. 12 was not legible and m. 203 notes were not read.

claims.claim: CFEO identifies French First Edition p. 2 as mm. 20-43, which includes m. 24.
claims.limit: The score image rendered blank/unsupported; notation at m. 24 is not full-score-verified. PTNA's section-A-at-m.24 statement is secondary only.
